source.author: verg
source.text: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, omnia tuta timens.
source.text_original: praesensit, motusque excepit prima futuros, / omnia tuta timens.
source.text_english: she foresaw it and first caught the future movements, fearing that all was safe.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: haec dico, non quo de te sinistrum quid metuam, sed quo pietatis affectu etiam, quae tuta sunt, pertimescam.
reuse.text_original: haec dico, non quo de te sinistrum quid metuam, sed quo pietatis affectu etiam, quae tuta sunt, pertimescam.
reuse.text_english: I say this not because I fear anything bad about you, but because with a feeling of devotion I even fear things that are safe.
